# David Smyers

> David Smyers is an author, pianist, and teacher whose work moves from the street to the spirit — memoir, music, and spiritual writing, including The Hustler's Handbook, with a new book on the way. Based in Arizona.

David Smyers writes in prose and metric verse, interweaving narrative and rhythm. His best-known book is The Hustler's Handbook (1999), a memoir grounded in 1950s street life; later work includes Spiritual Environmentalism: Healing Gems (Olive Press, 2020). As a pianist and composer he is known for attention to the Aeolian mode and modal craft.

## Contact
- Email: hello@davidsmyers.com
- Based in Arizona.

## Books
- The Hustler's Handbook (1999) — autobiography and memoir; street narrative meets metric verse. Available on Amazon: https://a.co/d/08HZVk3h
- Spiritual Environmentalism: Healing Gems (Olive Press Inc., 2020) — a short spiritual work. Publisher: https://olivepressbooks.com
- A new book is on the way.
